ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/cream pixels comprise approximately 80-85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels restricted to the perimeter and central junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A continuous low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge and outer tips. A vertical low-intensity column is centered at the median notch. The interior region consists of high-intensity white pixels with a diffuse, medium-intensity yellowish-tan overlay.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes along the entire trailing boundary. Notable peaks are clustered at the distal 1/3 of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep exhibiting a slight concave curve leading toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct, roughly circular low-intensity spots are visible: one prominent mark at the right-central lobe and a cluster of smaller spots on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 3-4 parallel, short dark linear marks are detected on the lower left quadrant of the fluke near the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, scattered circular indentations or pigmentation voids consistent with past parasitic attachment or barnacle sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-tan pigmentation film (diatom coverage) unevenly distributed across the high-intensity white regions.
